business_scope.primary_industry_name: Automated Algorithm Underwriting for Micro Consumer Loans

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (Unitary National Jurisdiction; International Company Regime under the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: World Trade Organization (WTO) Accession, effective 24 August 2012
Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (PICTA), in force for Vanuatu
Melanesian Spearhead Group Trade Agreement (MSGTA), in force for Vanuatu
Vanuatu Overseas Trade and Economic Relations Agreements under the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (limited bilateral investment protection network; no comprehensive US or EU BIT in force)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 6 of 2018 (AMLCFTA), as amended, and the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) surveillance regime; International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (IC Act), including registered office and registered agent obligations; Companies Act [Cap. 191], as amended, beneficial-ownership record-keeping requirements; Company and Trust Service Providers (CTSP) licensing regime administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook and guidance notes for licensed agents.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent notary public in the document holder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Vanuatu is a contracting party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; apostille required for Convention states; for non-Convention states, consular legalization through the nearest Vanuatu honorary consulate or the issuing state's Ministry of Foreign Affairs)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within the preceding 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed financial institution in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, plus notarization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter confirming account conduct and source of funds capacity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Current relationship bank of the beneficial owner or corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Addressed to the Vanuatu licensed registered agent; apostille/consular legalization required if demanded by the agent's risk policy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clearance certificate / certificate of good conduct for each director and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police authority or criminal records bureau of the country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source of wealth and source of funds declaration, signed under oath
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public together with a licensed accountant or lawyer certification
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille or consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional reference letter from a licensed lawyer, accountant, or regulated corporate service provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Independent professional referee in the applicant's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Direct transmission to the Vanuatu registered agent; apostille or consular legalization required for non-E/English-speaking jurisdictions

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every director, shareholder, signatory, and ultimate beneficial owner against the VFIU domestic PEP register, the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists, FATF public statements, and adverse-media/watchlist databases. Enhanced due diligence and senior-management approval are required for PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, and any connection to politically exposed persons or sanctioned entities, pursuant to AMLCFTA 2018 sections 17-20 and FATF Recommendations 12 and 22. Screening must occur at engagement and be refreshed on a continuous, event-driven basis during the life of the corporate relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Company Registry portal, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official legal names are registered in Latin script; English and French are accepted statutory languages. Accented characters, punctuation marks, and symbols are generally excluded from the legal name field unless expressly permitted by VFSC practice. The name must be distinct from every existing registered and reserved name in the VFSC database and must not create a likelihood of confusion with a foreign protected corporate name where the applicant has constructive notice. The legal name must end with an acceptable suffix such as Limited, Corporation, Incorporated, Societe Anonyme, or their abbreviations (Ltd, Corp, Inc, SA).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a formal name rejection notice from the VFSC Registry, the applicant or its licensed registered agent may file a written appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 calendar days of the rejection date. The appeal must state the grounds of distinctiveness, provide a certified search certificate, and propose at least one alternative name. The Registrar must render a decision within 21 working days of receipt of the complete appeal dossier. If the appeal is refused, the applicant may file a fresh name reservation application with a new primary name or seek judicial review in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the judicial review procedure of the Rules of the Supreme Court 2013. A single administrative extension of the name reservation for up to 30 additional days may be granted on written application to the Registrar before the initial reservation expires, subject to payment of the prescribed extension fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted only as an ancillary arrangement. The International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu and a licensed resident registered agent/provider under section 56 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. A virtual office address supplied by a third-party provider may support correspondence and administrative functions, but it cannot replace the statutory registered agent or the registered office address recorded with VFSC. At the pre-incorporation stage, no physical trading premises or employee presence in Vanuatu is required for the International Company structure.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-Moderate risk. Estimated probability of an unannounced physical inspection of the registered agent's address within the first 12 months is approximately 15-20% for a passive International Company under routine VFSC monitoring. The probability rises to approximately 30-40% if the beneficial owner, applicant name, or intended industry triggers a VFSC watchlist, adverse regulatory intelligence, or a mutual-evaluation follow-up visit by the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering. Note that the P2P micro-lending scope, if pursued under Vanuatu rather than in the target operating market, would require a separate regulatory license assessment and materially increases the likelihood of premises verification to approximately 50% at the licensing stage.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Vanuatu International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 (Cap. 222), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Acts of 2004, 2008 and 2014 (incorporation provisions, ss. 2-19; registered office, registered agent, director and officer provisions); International Companies (Fees) Regulations; Financial Services Commission Act No. 21 of 1999; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2020 (Act No. 7 of 2020).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registry of International Companies and International Trusts, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 - Application for Registration of an International Company, submitted with the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association, culminating in the Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. The Memorandum of Association states the authorised capital (market standard USD 1,000); paid-up capital may be nil at incorporation and called wholly or partly by the first board resolution. No escrow account or capital deposit is required by the VFSC; the statutory registration fee scales with authorised capital per the International Companies (Fees) Regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF VU-IC (INTERNATIONAL COMPANY). RESOLVED: (1) that the subscription presented by the subscriber, covering the issue of 1,000 ordinary shares of United States dollars one each at par, be approved and entered into the share register; (2) that the registered office be fixed at the office of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu, and the agent be authorised to represent the company; (3) that the founding director be appointed president, the corporate secretary be appointed, and such officers be authorised to open accounts, execute the micro-lending platform agreements and secure all required regulatory licences.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry of International Companies (submission through a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founder instructs a Vanuatu licensed registered agent to submit a name clearance request to the VFSC Names Registry window with three proposed names in priority order. The Registry screens the names against protected, reserved, objectionable and Government-sponsored words (including Bank, Trust, Assurance and Insurance). Upon approval, the name is reserved for 180 days. The agent simultaneously prepares the authorisation letter and AML/KYC pack of the beneficial owner.
required_dossiers: Name clearance request form (Form IC-1)
Registered Agent engagement and authorisation letter
Beneficial owner passport copies and proof of residential address (notarised)
AML/Client Due Diligence questionnaire of the proposed entity
Three proposed company names in priority order
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the preferred name is rejected, the agent immediately re-submits the reserve names without an additional fee; a discretionary appeal against refusal on public-interest or confusion grounds is available to the VFSC Registrar within 14 days under the International Companies Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent (responsible officer) and a Vanuatu notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association in English, setting out the authorised share capital, the subscriber's share subscription, the registered office at the agent's Port Vila address, and the objects clause authorising a global algorithm-assisted P2P micro-lending platform. The subscriber executes the document before a notary, the notarial attestation is appended, and the agent conducts a compliance review against the International Companies Act's restrictions on domestic business with Vanuatu residents.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association (final draft)
Articles of Association (final draft)
Consent to act as first director and first corporate secretary
AML/KYC final file of the beneficial owner
Opening entries for the share register
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC queries any constitutional clause, for example an objects clause bordering on domestic business, the agent files a corrective Notice of Alteration of Memorandum or Articles or executes a deed of rectification before notarial re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing of Application for Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry of International Companies (e-Registry portal or physical counter, Port Vila)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent submits the signed Form 1 application, the notarised Memorandum and Articles of Association, and the Declaration of Compliance confirming that the company qualifies as an International Company and will not carry on business with Vanuatu residents except as permitted. The statutory registration fee of VUV 25,000 (approximately USD 210) is remitted, the application is date-stamped, and the statutory review period begins.
required_dossiers: Form 1 - Application for Registration of an International Company (signed by the subscriber)
Memorandum and Articles of Association (notarised)
Declaration of Compliance signed by the registered agent
Consent to act forms of the first director and secretary
Proof of payment of the VUV 25,000 statutory registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a query, the agent has a 14-day statutory response window to file a corrective declaration or amended articles; a rejected application may be re-filed with a 50% surcharge, and a refusal may be challenged by judicial review in the Vanuatu Supreme Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Kit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar registers the company in the International Companies Register and issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the official seal and the company registration number, together with the Certificate of Registered Office and Registered Agent. The agent collects certified extracts and prepares the corporate kit comprising the company seal, share certificates, statutory registers and minute book.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (issued)
Certificate of Registered Office and Registered Agent (issued)
Certified copy of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
Corporate kit (company seal, embosser, share certificates)
Register of charges and initial statutory registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A clerical error in the certificate is curable by filing a Notice of Correction with the Registrar; the VFSC corrects the certificate within a short administrative cycle with no additional statutory fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolution: Share Subscription, Registered Office Adoption and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of VU-IC; minutes recorded by the corporate secretary; VFSC notified where required
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The first director convenes the inaugural board meeting, which may be held in-absentia or by unanimous written consent. The board approves the subscription contract for 1,000 ordinary shares at par, records the issue in the share register, adopts the registered agent's Port Vila office as the statutory registered office, retains the registered agent, and appoints the founding director as president and the corporate secretary. The signed resolution is minuted, share certificates are countersigned and sealed, and officer notifications are prepared for the VFSC.
required_dossiers: First board resolution (share subscription, registered office, officers)
Share subscription contract and share register entries
Officer consent forms
Registered office acceptance letter from the agent
Bank account opening KYC pack
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If shareholders object, a written shareholder resolution may rescind the board decision; a late officer filing with the VFSC attracts a minor late fee and is cured by submitting Form IC-4 within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Special Licence and AML/CFT Registration for the P2P Micro-Lending Platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Licensing and Enforcement Division; Financial Intelligence Unit of the Republic of Vanuatu; Port Vila Municipal Council (municipal business licence for physical office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The company submits a licensing file demonstrating that the platform matches non-resident borrowers and lenders exclusively through algorithmic underwriting, does not take deposits, and does not supply credit to Vanuatu residents. A Money Lender's Licence is obtained if any loan is extended to a Vanuatu resident under the Money Lenders Act; AML/CFT registration with the Financial Intelligence Unit is mandatory under the 2020 AML/CFT regime, with an annual supervision fee. For a leased office in Port Vila, the municipal business licence, fire safety, structural and occupational clearances described below must also be secured before platform operations commence.
required_dossiers: Money Lender's licence application Form ML-1 (if domestic loans are contemplated)
AML/CFT risk assessment and compliance manual
FIU registration certificate and annual supervision fee receipt
Fintech business plan and algorithmic underwriting operational flowchart
Legal opinion confirming non-deposit-taking and non-resident lending model
Corporate governance manual and beneficial ownership register
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the FIU or VFSC queries the AML manual, a corrective memorandum is resubmitted within 10 business days; an adverse licensing decision may be internally appealed to the VFSC Board and thereafter to the Financial Services Appeal Tribunal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Licensing and Enforcement Division, in conjunction with the Financial Intelligence Unit and the Registrar of Money Lenders under the Money Lenders Act; Port Vila Municipal Council for the municipal business licence.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Money Lender's Licence (Money Lenders Act) and AML/CFT Registration under the Vanuatu Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2020; a VFSC Dealers in Securities Licence under the Dealers in Securities Act is additionally required if the platform issues transferable loan tokens or tradable loan obligations.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC) of the Government of Vanuatu, established under the Environmental Protection Act No. 2 of 2003.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 4 - No Full EIA Required (Exempt). The activity is a digital-only lending platform with no construction, excavation, land disturbance or production process; a simple Environmental Compliance Declaration is filed with DEPC for the leased office premises in Port Vila.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to the platform's digital underwriting operations. Office wastewater must meet Port Vila municipal sewer acceptance limits under the Water Resources Act (BOD not exceeding 50 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 60 mg/L); no process VOCs or particulate emissions arise from server operations, which are hosted in third-party certified data centres; any emergency diesel generator must comply with ISO 8528 emission classes and smoke opacity not exceeding 40 per cent; e-waste must be disposed of exclusively through registered recyclers under the Vanuatu Waste Management Regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Vanuatu Police Force Urban Fire and Rescue Service (emergency exits, fire extinguisher test certificates, evacuation plan stamping); structural occupancy load certificate from the Public Works Department for the leased office (minimum live load 2.5 kPa); electrical wiring and safe-building certificate of compliance; occupational health and safety clearance under the Employment Act 2010 covering first-aid provisions, safe workstation layout and ergonomic assessment.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; administrative portal: Vanuatu Trade Information Portal and Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Services
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: No national income tax TIN is issued to exempt International Companies. For indirect tax purposes, the entity must register for VAT with the Commissioner of VAT by filing the prescribed VAT registration form, annexing the VFSC International Company certificate, evidence of business licensing, beneficial ownership schedule, projected turnover statement, and address details. Non-resident-owned ICs may register exclusively through a licensed Vanuatu registered agent or tax representative.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections are available. An International Company may elect to remain fully tax-exempt under the International Companies Act, may elect to be VFSC-licensed as a restricted financial institution for micro-lending, and may voluntarily elect VAT registration if it makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu. No further pass-through or corporate entity-level election exists.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 213]
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 3,000,000 annual taxable turnover in any consecutive 12-month period, subject to ministerial gazette adjustment
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing clearance, API stamping, or digital stamp mandate currently applies. VAT is self-assessed on standard prescribed invoices. The P2P micro-lending platform must maintain fully electronic transaction records, borrower agreements, invoice trails, and payment reconciliations accessible to DCIR and VFSC for AML and VAT audit purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is claimable for: (i) goods physically exported from Vanuatu under a valid customs export declaration; (ii) direct international transport services; and (iii) services supplied to non-residents that are wholly performed outside Vanuatu and not enjoyed in Vanuatu. The P2P platform may zero-rate its offshore administration and lending platform services only if the service is provided to non-resident borrowers and no service element is consumed in Vanuatu.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration approved by Vanuatu Customs
Bill of Lading or airway waybill evidencing physical export
Commercial invoice and zero-rating supporting schedule
Inward remittance certificate or foreign exchange receipt showing settlement offshore
Copy of VFSC International Company registration and VAT registration certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DCIR may reassess zero-rated supplies if documentary substantiation is incomplete or not produced within the applicable period, claw back any VAT refund received, impose interest from the original due date, and apply penalties of up to 200% of the evaded VAT. Fraudulent zero-rating claims may additionally trigger criminal prosecution, monetary penalties under the VAT Act, suspension or cancellation of the VFSC license, disqualification of directors, and anti-money-laundering enforcement under Vanuatu's Financial Transactions Reporting Act.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu vatu (VUV) is fully convertible for current account transactions; no exchange control legislation or capital account restrictions are in force. Non-resident shareholders may freely receive dividends, loan repayments, and liquidation proceeds through licensed banks. Profit remittance requires only standard commercial bank verification of source of funds and underlying transaction documentation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender requirement exists. Exporters and service providers may retain export proceeds in any permitted foreign currency and may credit them to foreign-currency accounts maintained with licensed domestic banks without mandatory conversion into VUV.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium. Vanuatu does not operate a local electronic money institution (EMI) licensing regime; the VFSC does not issue EMI licences. A Vanuatu International Company may not itself hold client funds or act as an EMI without a banking licence. However, the platform may engage a regulated offshore EMI or payment service provider (e.g., authorised under a reputable EU/UK/APAC regime) as a disbursement conduit, subject to RBV cross-border payment oversight and VFSC anti-money-laundering compliance requirements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical director presence is not statutorily mandated. Licensed banks in Vanuatu generally permit remote onboarding through video KYC interviews, notarised corporate documents, apostilled certificates of incumbency, and regulated-entity references. For high-risk lending platforms, the bank's compliance officer may require a virtual in-person meeting and additional ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) declarations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk sector classification (automated consumer lending / P2P fintech)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC International Company licence; Fintech Lender special authorisation; detailed business model narrative; algorithm description and credit underwriting methodology; AML/CFT policy and procedures manual; transaction monitoring framework; external audit confirmation of controlled environment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident directors and remote management structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copies of passports; proof of residential address; police good-conduct certificates from country of residence; director declaration and personal reference from a primary bank; notarised register of directors and beneficial owners; tax residence certificates.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border fund flows to borrowers in multiple jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Borrower onboarding KYC forms; credit risk management policy; list of target lending jurisdictions with sanctions screening evidence; originator and beneficiary due diligence; purpose codes matched to loan disbursements; robust adverse-media monitoring programme.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of offshore digital payment channels and non-bank wallets
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Service agreements with regulated EMI/PSP providers; licences and regulatory status of the PSP; written opinion confirming the PSP is not used for deposit-taking; audit trail of each loan disbursement; segregation of client funds from operational treasury accounts.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity or shareholder-loan capital must be remitted via SWIFT or correspondent banking to the Vanuatu entity's operational account at a licensed domestic bank. Acceptable purpose codes include 'Equity injection to affiliate' (e.g., SWIFT field 70/72 or bank-specific code such as 'LOAN' or 'CAPITAL') and 'Intercompany loan'. Verification requires a board resolution approving the capital injection, signed subscription agreement or loan agreement, UBO declaration, and source-of-wealth evidence. No RBV prior approval is required for inbound capital unless the value triggers suspicious transaction reporting thresholds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Loan disbursements to borrowers domiciled abroad are executed through (i) SWIFT MT103 for direct high-value payments to borrower bank accounts, or (ii) compliant local wallet payout rails / ACH where the borrower has connected its wallet to the platform. For trade-settlement disbursements to vendors supporting the platform's operations (e.g., software procurement), a commercial letter of credit (LC) via a Vanuatu bank's correspondent network may be used, with underlying invoices, purchase orders, and shipping/software delivery evidence. All outbound payments must include accurate purpose codes and comply with local AML record-keeping rules.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanuatu vatu non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) with offshore counterparties (no RBV restriction on NDF contracts referencing VUV)
Cross-currency swaps between USD and VUV with licensed international banks
Vanuatu vatu forward contracts available from local commercial banks (only for genuine current-account exposure)
Foreign currency options on USD/VUV purchased from regulated broker-dealers

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual License Renewal (Annual Government Fee) for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each anniversary of the date of incorporation; VFSC registry business hours apply.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs a monthly penalty of 10% of the outstanding annual fee. Continued delinquency beyond 90 days allows VFSC to issue a warning notice and proceed with administrative strike-off and dissolution of the International Company.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is imposed on a standard non-licensed International Company. A compulsory independent audit applies only if the entity holds a VFSC financial services licence (e.g. micro-lending or payment service licence) and the licence conditions require an annual audited report. There is no asset or revenue threshold triggering audit for a non-licensed International Company.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: For non-licensed International Companies no prescribed accounting framework applies; books must be maintained to adequately explain transactions and financial position. If a VFSC financial services licence requires audited financial statements, the governing framework is IFRS as adopted for Vanuatu financial services reporting.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must maintain the Register of Beneficial Owners at the registered office. At each annual licence renewal, the directors must confirm to the registered agent and VFSC that the beneficial ownership information is accurate and current. Any transfer of shareholding entitling beneficial ownership change must be recorded in the UBO register and filed with VFSC within 14 days of the transfer. Failure to maintain an accurate UBO register may result in monetary penalties and potential strike-off.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500 – USD 7,500 per annum if a VFSC lending licence mandates an independent audit; otherwise no audit cost applies.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (nil corporate income tax on Vanuatu International Companies)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory exemption under s.54 International Companies Act (Cap 222): ICs, their shareholders and directors are exempt from all Vanuatu income tax, capital gains tax, dividend tax and stamp duty on offshore instruments; no VAT/GST applies to lending income earned exclusively from non-resident borrowers; total domestic effective tax burden on qualifying offshore P2P lending income: 0%.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu. The equivalent compliance filing is the VFSC Annual Return (renewal declaration) submitted through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Corporate Registry online e-portal (https://www.vfsc.vu). The return confirms the company name, registration number, registered office, resident agent, directors, secretary (if any), shareholders and compliance status, and is accompanied by payment of the annual license fee.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, due on each anniversary date of incorporation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The renewal fee and Annual Return must be lodged on or before the anniversary of incorporation each year. There is no statutory extension relative to the 31 December fiscal year-end; the late penalty regime operates from the first calendar day following the due date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The unique VFSC registration number in the International Companies Register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the number shown on the Certificate of Incorporation; do not apply for a domestic tax file number, as exempt ICs are not registered with the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs authority.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name and any approved foreign name or alias.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Name must match the Certificate of Incorporation and any current change of name certificate; non-resident controllers should verify global trademark conflicts before renewal.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 — Registered Office and Resident Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Address of the registered office in Vanuatu and identity of the VFSC-licensed agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident owned IC, the licensed agent in Port Vila remains the statutory point of service; changes of agent must be filed before the renewal due date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses, nationality and holdings of all directors and shareholders (or of nominees if bearer shares are in custody).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident individuals may use their residential address outside Vanuatu; nominee or trust structures must disclose the custodian or beneficial owner to the agent for AML compliance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of the company's permitted offshore activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State automated algorithm underwriting and peer-to-peer micro-lending to non-residents only; expressly confirm no Vanuatu-resident borrowers and no Vanuatu land holding.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the company has not contravened the IC Act (deposit-taking, banking, insurance or prohibited domestic activity).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Signatory director attests remotely by resolution; foreign directors remain jointly liable for false attestations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late renewal attracts a penalty of 10% of the annual license fee for each month (or part of a month) after the anniversary date, accumulating up to a maximum equal to the fee. An IC in default for more than one month is liable to compulsory strike-off; a struck-off IC cannot transact, and reinstatement requires full arrears, restoration fees and written VFSC approval.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (no Vanuatu withholding tax). Dividends paid by an IC to non-resident shareholders are exempt under s.54 of the International Companies Act; there is no domestic dividend withholding tax law in Vanuatu.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable. Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) and therefore no treaty relief procedure, tax residence certificate (TRC) or WHT reclaim channel. Limited tax information exchange agreements (TIEAs) exist for exchange of information only and do not reduce withholding rates. For a foreign parent, the operative proof of exempt status is the VFSC Certificate of Good Standing and annual renewal receipt, which should be presented to the offshore lender's own revenue authority in any CFC/controlled-foreign-company filing.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding tax on cross-border royalties and interest paid by a Vanuatu IC; no treaty override is required because no domestic WHT is imposed on payments to non-residents.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold in Vanuatu (VUV 0): Vanuatu imposes no transfer pricing law, no Master File/Local File obligation and no contemporaneous documentation duty on ICs. Group prudential benchmark: maintain Local/Master File evidence where total intercompany transactions reach VUV 120,000,000 (approximately USD 1,000,000) to support foreign-parent OECD compliance and to rebut evasion allegations.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No domestic Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) apply in Vanuatu. However, statutory substance requirements operate through the IC Act: an IC must maintain a VFSC-licensed resident agent, a registered office in Vanuatu and accessible accounting records at the registered office or as the agent directs. An IC loses its exemption if it carries on business with Vanuatu residents, holds a beneficial interest in Vanuatu land, or does not hold the required license for banking, insurance, deposit-taking or trust business. P2P lending to non-residents through foreign payment rails (ACH/wallet payouts) is consistent with the exemption only if all origination and collection counterparties are non-residents.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML-CFT Breach by Unlicensed Micro-Lending Platform
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the P2P lending platform as an IC without a VFSC financial services license while taking custody of borrower funds, executing domestic payment rails, or failing to apply customer due diligence, beneficial-owner identification, transaction monitoring and suspicious-transaction reporting on loan flows; proceeds derived from fraud or organized crime knowingly processed through the platform.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Bodies corporate: fines up to VUV 100,000,000 under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act (No. 16 of 2022), freezing and confiscation of platform assets, suspension or revocation of the IC registration, and disqualification of the resident agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners are individually liable to imprisonment of up to 15 years, personal asset confiscation orders, travel bans and exit controls pending forfeiture proceedings, and civil restitution to defrauded lenders and borrowers; courts may pierce the corporate veil where the IC is a mere conduit.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Breach of International Company Exemption (Shell/Prohibited Domestic Activity)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC as a shell with no registered agent or Vanuatu records, failing to file the annual return and license fee, soliciting Vanuatu-resident borrowers, holding a beneficial interest in Vanuatu land, or engaging in deposit-taking / banking / insurance without the mandatory license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of the s.54 tax exemption; late-payment penalties of 10% per month up to the full fee; compulsory strike-off and deregistration; restoration only upon payment of arrears and VFSC restoration fees; contracts concluded after strike-off are unenforceable and income becomes taxable under residual Vanuatu tax laws, including VAT at 12.5% on local fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for debts incurred after strike-off or after prohibited domestic activity begins; courts may disregard limited liability under fraudulent trading principles; directors face disqualification orders, fines, and imprisonment up to 12 years for making false declarations to the VFSC.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Cross-Border Tax Evasion and CFC Recharacterization
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Fabricating Vanuatu substance documentation (rented desks, hollow board minutes, back-dated loan agreements) while the platform is effectively managed in a charging jurisdiction; concealing chargeable profits of the substantial financing activity behind the tax-exempt IC; failure to file the IC's profits in the beneficial owners' residence country and abuse of foreign CFC exemptions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu: false attestations to the VFSC attract fraud penalties, agent de-licensing, and registry strike-off; information is exchanged under TIEAs for criminal and civil tax matters. Foreign: reassessment of the full platform profit, denial of tax treaty protection, penalties up to 200% of the tax sought, and interest running from the original due date.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face criminal fraud prosecutions in the residence jurisdiction, worldwide restraining orders and extradition requests; civil discovery pierces nominee layers, and fraudulent trading rulings make each director personally liable for the entire group shortfall, including the lender losses and revenue authorities' costs.
